chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

exercises.name: Add the third chord
exercises.purpose: Learn the three-finger G shape and check every string rings.

params.fingers: middle(2) on low E 3rd fret, index(1) on A-string 2nd fret, ring(3) on high e 3rd fret

exercises.coaching: Middle finger on the fat low E string, third fret. Index on the A string, second fret. Ring on the thin high e string, third fret. Strum all six. Check each string one at a time — the B string usually gets muted by a lazy ring finger, so arch that knuckle.

exercises.name: Change in pairs
exercises.purpose: Practise the two changes you have not drilled yet.

params.action: one-minute change count on each pair

exercises.coaching: Two new pairs. First G to Em and back for a minute — count the clean ones. Then easy C to G for a minute. Do the pairs before the song and the song plays itself.

exercises.name: The four-bar loop
exercises.purpose: Play a real, complete-sounding progression all the way round.

params.action: four down-strums per chord, loop four times
params.cue: land the change on beat 1, never stop the strumming hand

exercises.coaching: Here is your song shape: G, Em, easy C, back to G. Four strums each, round and round. That loop is in thousands of songs, and it is yours now. Start at 55 beats per minute. Slow and steady beats fast and lumpy.

exercises.name: Play it through, no stopping
exercises.purpose: Perform the loop start to finish without restarting.

params.rule: mistakes are allowed, stopping is not

exercises.coaching: Eight times through, no stops. If a chord comes out fuzzy, keep going — the next bar is already coming. Playing through mistakes is a skill of its own, and it is the one that turns practice into performance.

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: Three chords is all it takes to sound like you are playing a song. Today you get the third one and loop them together.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex1_intro: G: middle on the low E third fret, index on the A string second fret, ring on the high e third fret. Arch that ring finger so the B string still rings.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex2_intro: Drill the two new pairs first — G to Em, then easy C to G. One minute each, clean changes only.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex3_intro: Now the loop: G, Em, easy C, G. Four strums each at 55bpm. Change on beat one and keep that hand moving.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex4_intro: Eight times through with no stopping. Fuzzy chords are fine. Freezing is the only mistake.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: Round the loop without stopping and you have played a song's worth of guitar. That is the milestone.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: Three chords, one loop, no stopping. Everything from here is more shapes and better rhythm — you already know how the game works.

lesson.title: Your First 3-Chord Song
lesson.one_line_promise: Loop three chords in time and it finally sounds like a song.
objectives: Form the three-finger G major shape with all six strings ringing
Change cleanly between G and Em, and between easy C and G
Play the G–Em–C–G loop at four beats per chord
Get through eight repeats without stopping the strumming hand

free_metronome: 55bpm for the four-bar loop and the play-through
